title: MineBerry
description: MineBerry was opened on December 29th, 2019. Ever since, our server's player base is intermittently growing since it's first opened, users around all over the world playing our amazing gamemodes and enjoying their time here with our beloved community.
body:
### Discover MineBerry, The New-Generation Minecraft Server!

Launched on December 29th, 2019, MineBerry quickly became a home for thousands of players all over the world. Join today for enjoyable lag-free gameplay and continuous updates on our server.

- **Server IP: go.mineberry.org**
- **Server Store: https://mineberry.org/**
- **Discord: https://mineberry.org/discord**


We offer 9 Amazing GameModes To Play:


<details>
<summary>BedWars (1k+ Players!)</summary>

Protect your bed along with your teammates and destroy enemy beds to win!

</details>



<details>
<summary>SkyWars (1k+ Players!)</summary>

A war in the sky. Spawn on a floating island and be the last alive. Find chests, mine for resources and kill everyone.

</details>



<details>
<summary>Murder Mystery (500+ Players!)</summary>

1 Murderer. 1 Detective. And a whole of Innocents. Can you survive this tense social game of betrayal and murder?

</details>



<details>
<summary>Practice (500+ Players!)</summary>

Become a dueling master by battling players in various modes: from classing PvP to fights on TheBridge, FireBall Fight, StickFight, and Sumo!

</details>



<details>
<summary>Build Battle (500+ Players!)</summary>

Create a build from a given theme within 5 minutes. Rate other players builds and try to score as many points as possible for your own!

Modes: Solo, Teams, SpeedBuilders

</details>



<details>
<summary>Survival</summary>

Survive like in singleplayer, But with others. Fight, trade, build your own base or even a town with your community.

</details>



<details>
<summary>OP Survival</summary>

Modern OP survival mode where you can just survive and have fun with a lot of stuff to do. Great for friends.

</details>



<details>
<summary>Anarchy</summary>

Hardcore vanilla survival with griefing allowed and no area claiming. Scam, grief, kill and break everything you see. Almost no rules!

</details>



<details>
<summary>KitPvP</summary>

Fight players to earn coins and upgrade your level. Get a better kits and abilities. Improve your PvP skills and try to get a place in the leaderboard.


</details>




Dive into MineBerry today for a unique Minecraft experience!
